messages:
sarah.m: quick heads-up — i'm pulling together the post-launch webinar narrative + a short benchmark-led battlecard. need to lock the competitive hooks vs cloud AI platforms and LLM APIs. agenda: hero bench claims, 3 rebuttals, routing + follow-up CTAs. :thinking_face:

mike.r: sounds good. can you paste the top 3 claims you want us to front-load? trying to keep slides lean. :eyes:

sarah.m: current thinking — 1) predictable p99 latency at scale, 2) 20-40% lower token cost on typical seq lengths via batching+kv caching, 3) unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private (same API + rollouts). want numbers to be defensible in the battlecard.

alex.p: i can add the microbench numbers from last week's perf run. caveat: the cost delta depends a lot on seq dist and model size. we should include an example table and an annotation.

sarah.m: yes — example table is great. mike, can you draft the short soundbites for slide deck? 1-2 lines each.

mike.r: draft: "Redwood Inference: predictable latency, 1/3 the ops overhead, built for production economics" — maybe too punchy. open to edits.

jordan: maybe swap "1/3 the ops overhead" for "lower per-token cost at production scale" — avoids an ops metric we can't substantiate broadly.

emily.k: for the battlecard rebuttals vs cloud vendors: 1) vs managed cloud endpoints — emphasize unified API + fallback model variants and on-prem option, 2) vs LLM APIs — emphasize deployment flexibility and cost controls (batching, caching, quantization recs), 3) vs infra vendors — emphasize turnkey observability + rollouts (canary/A-B + tracing).

ravi: routing + inbound note — if webinar mentions Dedicated, we should add clear inbound tags for SDRs: "Dedicated interest", "Enterprise compliance", "Proof-of-concept request". recommend an initial form with checkboxes and auto-label rules.

sarah.m: perfect. can you sketch the exact form labels and the routing rules? include preferred follow-up: AM + solutions eng if "Dedicated interest" checked.

ravi: sketch: ```form fields: company, size, use-case, deployment preference [Hosted/Dedicated/Private], compliance checkbox [HIPAA, SOC2], preferred follow-up [AM/SE] routing: Dedicated->AM+SE, Private->Enterprise-SE+security-ops, Hosted->growth SDR```

alex.p: for the battlecard tech snippets we should include quick rebut copy: e.g., "They say managed endpoints remove ops - we say managing inference economics at scale requires runtime features (KV caching, continuous batching) and deployment controls." short and scannable.

mike.r: love that. also want a one-paragraph blog post that ties the webinar benchmarks to a customer success story — can someone volunteer a 300-word draft?

emily.k: i'll take the draft. will weave in the benchmark examples and routing CTA. aim to circulate by EOD Thurs.

sarah.m: timeline: finalize battlecard copy + slides by Wed, routing rules and form by Thu, blog + slide rehearsal Fri. can everyone react with :thumbsup: if that works.

ops-bot: Reminder: marketing webinar slot reserved for 2026-05-12 11:00 PDT — recording and slides auto-post to #events after session.

mike.r: :thumbsup:

alex.p: :thumbsup: added perf table placeholder in the shared drive (link in thread).

emily.k: :thumbsup: will share draft soon.

sarah.m: thanks team — i'll push a consolidated PR to the battlecard doc and link it here when ready. :rocket:
